retained_nonconflicting_source.other_rules: All previously effective decisions and source values survive where not contradicted by this overlay.

rest: Clear the live buff/state layer without deleting learned skills, equipment, or other permanent build ownership.
No new mana, consumable, money, experience, skill-point or other resource reward is inferred from the rest decision.
Keep a room visit separate from the existing floor transition so resting cannot invoke the floor flask reset.
e2: Clip boat motion to its first room-boundary contact and park there; do not refuse launch solely because its projected full route would leave the room.
Keep the original cast clock running while parked. Do not reset or extend the source voyage lifetime, create an early burst, or invent indefinite persistence.
Until the original boarding deadline, apply the existing exact-current-point landing legality check at the parked point. Illegal boarding preserves the boat and does not project the hero inward.
At the original natural voyage deadline use the actual parked endpoint for the original burst or H10 lure branch; preserve the original H10 duration and closed boarding window.
H09 follows only the actual already travelled route back; wall traversal and original per-target ledgers remain, with no new periodic parked damage.
Boundary footprint/tolerance details belong to the production geometry implementation and are not stated as exact user instructions.
p2: Use an explicit successful-use milestone and cast identity to separate counting, becoming ready and one atomic later consumption.
Do not count previews, rejected inputs, incomplete timeouts, Q3 collapse, E2 boarding, or H12 return as additional completed casts.

AP snapshot timing, same-time tie-breaks, capped-stack refresh, history after expiry, and Hex-derived damage attribution need explicit production conventions; this approval does not pretend the user specified those details.
e3: Build the actual eligible participant set under existing Boss/H11/H12 rules, compute every required destination with the appropriate actor footprint, then validate the complete set before committing any movement.
The same all-or-none legality rule applies to H12 current return; a rejected return does not retroactively undo the already completed original exchange.
Retain the original live A or H12 window after a rejected attempt and do not start an extra cooldown; this is a production continuity choice, not a quoted new timing rule.

r2_candidate_plan.fixed_domain: Preserve original fixed domain/range for now; recalculate targets at each peak event instead of making the domain chase an enemy.
r2_candidate_plan.peak_footprint: Start with a compact circular footprint candidate of radius 2m, independent of the old 18x4m line; tune after concrete balance/readability work.
r2_candidate_plan.targeting: For each event, evaluate legal points in the original domain and room, using enemy centers plus pair midpoints as candidates; maximize the number of currently living hostile bodies overlapped by the candidate peak footprint. Equal counts use deterministic actor/coordinate order. Recompute every event. Do not add a Boss weighting.
r2_candidate_plan.empty_domain: Consume the scheduled peak event and show a non-damaging peak at a legal domain point; do not bank unspent events for later or increase the total.
r2_candidate_plan.base_schedule: Candidate: N events at t=k*D/N for k=0..N-1, first at activation, all before original expiry. N is exactly 7/9/13/20 and D retains the original rank duration. First beat and formula are production proposals, not exact user numbers.
r2_candidate_plan.new_damage_table: Author a separate four-rank per-peak flat/AP table under the granted balancing discretion; no implicit fallback to old line values and no claim of balanced damage before that table is set and evaluated.
r2_candidate_plan.h15: Do not use the base N assertion to silently disable interval reduction or to invent a new H15 result; explicitly version the modifier schedule and new total count before opening it.
